🎬 Verity (2026)

Verity is a psychological thriller based on Colleen Hoover’s bestselling novel, following Lowen Ashleigh, a struggling writer who receives an unexpected opportunity to complete a successful book series after its famous author, Verity Crawford, becomes unable to continue writing. Hired by Verity’s husband, Jeremy Crawford, Lowen moves into the family’s home to review years of manuscripts, notes, and unfinished material. What initially appears to be a career-changing opportunity soon takes a disturbing turn when she discovers a mysterious manuscript containing shocking revelations about Verity’s life, marriage, and family. As Lowen becomes increasingly involved in the Crawford household, she develops a complicated attraction to Jeremy while struggling to understand the unsettling secrets surrounding his wife. The deeper she investigates, the more difficult it becomes to distinguish truth from manipulation, leaving her questioning everything she believes about the family. With disturbing discoveries, dangerous emotional attachments, and an atmosphere filled with suspicion, Verity explores obsession, deception, grief, jealousy, and the terrifying consequences of hidden secrets.

🎭 Genre: Psychological Thriller • Mystery • Drama

source_details.synopsis: Verity is a 2026 American erotic psychological thriller film directed by Michael Showalter, written by Nick Antosca, and based on Colleen Hoover's 2018 novel. The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett. Verity had its world premiere at the Curzon Mayfair Cinema in London on September 24, 2026, and was released by Amazon MGM Studios in the United States and Canada on October 2, 2026. The film received mixed reviews from critics and has grossed $172.5 million against a production budget of $40 million.
